newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AWB sells no wheat in tenth tender.
newsitem.headline: AWB sells no wheat in tenth tender.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) rejected all bids and sold no wheat in its tenth domestic tender from its wheat pool.
Bids were submitted for 2,000 tonnes of old crop wheat and 18,000 tonnes of new crop wheat in Newcastle, Port Kembla, Geelong and Fremantle, AWB said.
No bids were successful, it said.
The AWB said highest failed bids in A$ a tonne were:
Port Zone Grade Bids Newcastle ASW 148 Feed old crop 22 Port Kembla ASW 140 Geelong AH13 202 Fremantle AH13 200
Closing date for the next tender is November 20.
NOTE - ASW: Australian Standard White; APW: Australian Premium White; AH: Australian Hard; APH: Australian Prime Hard; SHAR is a high protein hard Victorian wheat.
